CROSS-REFERENCE.

SUBJECT: - Groehl.

Groehl writing to Otten on 16.2.39 from Paris, enclosed a continuation of the report. + He said that he was very interested in the "Propelmann". His own affairs had made no progress and he thought the French police very incompetent.

+ report on Switzerland.
